decisive_items: Biopsy of posterior left pleural thickening showed CD5+, CD10−, non-germinal center B-cell type
Avid irregular enhancement within the right cavernous sinus and enlargement of the right side compared with the left
response.rationale: Biopsy-proven CD5+ non-germinal center B-cell lymphoma with systemic nodal and pleural involvement best fits DLBCL; cavernous sinus enhancement is secondary involvement. Tolosa-Hunt lacks such biopsy evidence and systemic disease. Sarcoidosis is unsupported by biopsy and lacks characteristic non-caseating granulomas.

rejected.why: Sinus and lymphadenopathy are nonspecific; no granulomatous pathology or other sarcoid features.
Cavernous sinus enhancement is explained by lymphomatous infiltration given biopsy-proven B-cell lymphoma and systemic disease.
